summary: Name the oldest live read in the WAL checkpoint log when a snapshot pins the WAL

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild, and no claim is projected differently. Diagnostics only.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change.

recovery.detail: The daemon records each read checkout and each read snapshot with its start time and call site in an in-memory list, one short lock per read. When the WAL checkpoint has copied no further for three samples in a row, its log line, which is reported in the abnormal bucket, adds how long the oldest live read has run, whether it is a snapshot or a lent connection, and where it was taken, plus how many reads are live. An idle pooled connection with a half-stepped statement is not on the list, so a pin with no live read points at one. No behaviour changes.
